notes_for_orch:

Final numbers (Versal xcvc1902):

  LUT   8255 (cap 80k — 10× headroom)

ROOT CAUSE of the v2/v3 failures (worth recording for future HLS tasks):
  `#pragma HLS PIPELINE II=1` on an OUTER loop forces HLS to FULLY UNROLL every
  inner loop to fit the pipeline. My matmul stages had PIPELINE on the j-loop
  with a k-reduction inside → HLS unrolled the entire 384/1536-wide k-dimension
  → 1500+ DSPs and 500-776 URAMs.
  FIX (v4): move PIPELINE down onto the k0-chunk loop. Now HLS pipelines the
  reduction at K_UR=8 MACs/cycle → 36 DSP total. This is the exact structure
  that made T0025 GVSA pass one-shot — I should have matched it from the start.

v4 ATTEMPT COUNT: 4 (v1 compile err, v2 over-cap, v3 wrong-fix, v4 correct-fix).

T0029 IS NOW UNBLOCKED & FEASIBLE:
  Per your directive, T0029 will time-multiplex ONE v4 instance 12× (not inline
  12 copies). Time-multiplexed: stays ~36 DSP + ~72-120 URAM + 12 weight sets
  in BRAM. Inlining would be 432 DSP / 864 URAM (URAM overflow again) — will NOT
  do that.
